description: Native derivability of a named formula \(A\) from \(U\) is equivalent to truth of \(A\) in every nonempty structure and shared name assignment satisfying all members of \(U\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.namedDerives_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (U : Set (L.Formula ℕ))
  (A : L.Formula ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.NamedDerives U A ↔
    ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [inst : L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] (a : ℕ → M), (∀ B ∈ U, B.Realize a) → A.Realize a
